title: Gyb: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier contain a denial-of-service vulnerability due to quadratic-time complexity in decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs, character strings, and indefinite-length ANY types. This occurs when decoding many fixed-size fragments, causing excessive CPU usage. The issue affects BER and CER decoding and certain non-conforming DER inputs. An attacker supplying crafted ASN.1 input to an affected decoder can cause CPU exhaustion. No confidentiality or integrity impact is reported.
